entities.name_en: Ministry of the Interior of the Republic of Croatia

evidence.note: pitanja@mup.hr, press@mup.hr; website is mup.gov.hr but email domain is mup.hr
policija@mup.hr, pitanja@mup.hr, press@mup.hr — police uses the MUP mail domain

entities.notes: Police is a directorate within MUP; border policing (Uprava za granicu) is part of the police, hence no separate border_guard entity.

entities.name_en: Ministry of Defence of the Republic of Croatia

evidence.note: 23 addresses listed, e.g. pisarnica@morh.hr, press@morh.hr, kabinet@morh.hr
VSOA has no own website or published email; its pages on morh.hr list MORH contacts (pisarnica@morh.hr etc.). No distinct VSOA mail domain evidenced.

entities.notes: VSOA operates within MORH; contact routed through MORH addresses.

entities.name_en: Office of the National Security Council

evidence.note: Contact page lists only postal address, phone and fax — no email published; domain assumed from website uvns.hr

entities.notes: Central state authority for information security and coordination of the security-intelligence system; also NSA/CSA function.
Operates within CARNET (Croatian Academic and Research Network), not under SOA. SK@CERT could not be verified as a current distinct national CERT.

evidence.note: ChatGPT: seen on official site; Claude: seen in third-party source; Qwen: seen on official site

entities.notes: Central state body for technical information security (crypto, TEMPEST); runs ZSIS CERT for government bodies.

gaps: border_guard: no separate border guard body — border policing (Uprava za granicu) is a directorate within the Croatian Police under MUP (covered by hr-policija).
gendarmerie: no gendarmerie-type force exists in Croatia.
other_natsec: Operativno-tehnički centar za nadzor telekomunikacija (OTC) exists in law (ZSOS 2006) but has no public website or evidenced mail domain — not included to avoid inventing domains.
UVNS and ZSIS publish no email addresses on their contact pages; mail domains assumed from their websites.
VSOA has no distinct website or mail domain; uses MORH infrastructure (morh.hr).
